name: Property Tax (ad valorem, 1% general levy)
notes: Article XIII A, section 1 says the maximum ad valorem tax on real property shall not exceed 1% of full cash value, collected by the counties and apportioned according to law to the districts within the counties. The limit does not apply to the voter-approved debt described in subdivision (b). The Auditor-Controller's fiscal year 2026-27 tax-rate-area fund composition lists fund 0059, '1 PCT TAX LIMITATION,' at 1.000000, and lists other funds, including voter-debt funds, with a figure in a column headed Tax Rate. Those other figures differ by tax rate area and are not recorded as rates of this tax. The same year's direct-charge narratives describe special assessments one by one, including assessments the City of Vacaville renews under the Landscaping and Lighting Act of 1972. Each of those is its own charge. None is recorded here. A collected dollar amount for the 1% levy was not in a document opened for this record. The FY2024-25 ACFR was also opened. Its printed p. 185 (PDF p. 193) reports $848,061,766 of collections for the 2025 levy; printed p. 168 (PDF p. 176) reports $1,055,324,306 in Property Tax Collection custodial-fund collections and $1,075,969,140 in distributions. Those schedules do not isolate the 1% general levy, and custodial distributions are not expenditures by the receiving governments. None of those totals is used as revenue of this record.

rates.applies_to: full cash value of real property (general levy; maximum under article XIII A, section 1)
